custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২৫ কাটা যাবে।

DPE-Main.question: ১) Choose the correct spelling.
DPE-Main.option1: Incendescent
DPE-Main.option2: Incandascent
DPE-Main.option3: Incandescent
DPE-Main.option4: Incundescent
DPE-Main.exp:
• The correct spelling is "Incandescent" (Adjective).

• Incandescent:
- English Meaning: Producing a bright light from a heated filament or other part; characterized by glowing zeal: ardent.
- Bangla Meaning: উত্তপ্ত হলে আলো দেয় বা দিতে পারে এমন; ভাস্বর।

• Example sentence: The incandescent lamp illuminated the entire room.
- Bangla Meaning: জ্বলন্ত/দীপ্তিমান বাতিটি পুরো ঘরটি আলোকিত করেছিল।

Source: Merriam-Webster Dictionary, Oxford Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary.

DPE-Main.question: ২) Only honesty can earn lasting respect. (make it negative)
DPE-Main.option1: None but honesty cannot earn lasting respect.
DPE-Main.option2: Nothing but honesty can earn lasting respect.
DPE-Main.option3: Not only honesty can earn lasting respect.
DPE-Main.option4: Only nothing but honesty can earn lasting respect.
DPE-Main.exp:
• Only যুক্ত Affirmative Sentence কে Negative Sentence এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Only এর পরিবর্তে none but/ Nothing but / not more than অথবা not less than বসে।
- ব্যক্তির ক্ষেত্রে Only এর পরিবর্তে None but বসবে।
- বস্তুর ক্ষেত্রে Only এর পরিবর্তে Nothing but বসবে।
- সংখ্যা বোঝালে তা পরিবর্তিত হয়ে not more than অথবা not less than বসবে।
- বাক্যের বাকী অংশ অপরিবর্তিত রয়ে যাবে।

• Affirmative sentence: Only honesty can earn lasting respect. 
• Negative sentence: Nothing but honesty can earn lasting respect.

Source:
1. English Wizard by Live Publications.
2. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.

DPE-Main.question: ৩) Because of her working hard, she passed the examination. (Make it complex)
DPE-Main.option1: Since she worked hard, she passed the examination.
DPE-Main.option2: Although she worked hard, she passed the examination.
DPE-Main.option3: Since she works hard, she passed the examination.
DPE-Main.option4: Although she works hard, she passed the examination.
DPE-Main.exp:
• Because of যুক্ত Simple Sentence কে Complex Sentence এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে since বসে,
- subject বসে,
- verb বসে,
- Adjective/ noun বসে,
- Comma বসে,
- অপর বাক্যটি বসে।

• Simple sentence: Because of her working hard, she passed the examination. 
• Complex sentence: Since she worked hard, she passed the examination.

• Example:
- Simple sentence: Because of their playing well, they won the game.
- Complex sentence: Since they played well, they won the game.

Source:
1. English Wizard by Live Publications.
2. Advanced Learners Communicative English by Chowdhury and Hossain.

DPE-Main.question: ৪) The school is going to organize a cultural program. (Make it passive)
DPE-Main.option1: A cultural program is being going to be organized by the school.
DPE-Main.option2: A cultural program is gone to be organized by the school.
DPE-Main.option3: A cultural program was going to be organized by the school.
DPE-Main.option4: A cultural program is going to be organized by the school.
DPE-Main.exp:
• be going to দিয়ে Active Voice থাকলে তা Passive Voice এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Active voice এর Object টি Passive voice এর Subject হিসেবে বসে।
- Tense অনুযায়ী Auxiliary Verb বসে।
- going to এর কোন পরিবর্তন হয় না।
- going to এরপর be বসে।
- মূল verb এর Past participle form বসে।
- by বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এ Object হিসেবে বসে।

• Active Voice: The school is going to organize a cultural program.
• Passive Voice: A cultural program is going to be organized by the school.

Source:
1. English Wizard by Live Publications.
2. Advanced Learners Communicative English by Chowdhury and Hossain.

DPE-Main.question: ৫) The antonym of the word "Ignorance" is -
DPE-Main.option1: Illiteracy
DPE-Main.option2: Idiocy
DPE-Main.option3: Similarity
DPE-Main.option4: Knowledge
DPE-Main.exp:
• Ignorance (Noun):
- English meaning: a lack of knowledge or information about something.
- Bangla meaning: অজ্ঞতা; অজ্ঞানতা; অনভিজ্ঞান; অনভিজ্ঞতা।

• উল্লিখিত অপশনগুলো,
ক) Illiteracy - নিরক্ষরতা।

খ) Idiocy - চরম বুদ্ধিহীনতা; বুদ্ধিজাড্য; অজ্ঞান।

গ) Similarity - সাদৃশ্য।

ঘ) Knowledge -  জ্ঞান; অভিজ্ঞতা।

• সুতরাং, অপশন বিবেচনা করে দেখা যায় যে, The antonym of the word "Ignorance" is - Knowledge.

Source: Merriam-Webster Dictionary, Oxford Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary.

DPE-Main.question: ৬) The teacher made the students clean the classroom. (Make it passive)
DPE-Main.option1: The students were made to be cleaned the classroom by the teacher.
DPE-Main.option2: The students were made to clean the classroom by the teacher.
DPE-Main.option3: The students were made to cleaned the classroom by the teacher.
DPE-Main.option4: The classroom was made to be clean by the teacher.
DPE-Main.exp:
• Make, See, Feel, Let, Know, Hear, Bid, Dare, Watch ইত্যাদি Verb থাকলে Active Voice কে Passive Voice রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Active voice এর Object টি Passive voice এর Subject হিসেবে বসে।
- Tense অনুযায়ী Auxiliary Verb বসে।
- মূল verb এর Past participle form বসে।
- Make, See, Feel, Let, Know, Hear, Bid, Dare, Watch ইত্যাদি Verb থাকলে Active Voice এ to উহ্য থাকে।
- কিন্তু Passive করার সময় তাদের পর to বসে এবং ২য় verb টির Present form বসে।
- তবে, Let Verb টির পরে Active ও Passive Voice এ To বসে না। 
- by বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এ object হিসেবে বসে। 

• Active Voice: The teacher made the students clean the classroom. 
• Passive Voice: The students were made to clean the classroom by the teacher.

Source:
1. English Wizard by Live Publications.
2. Advanced Learners Communicative English by Chowdhury and Hossain.

DPE-Main.question: ৭) The proverb “Jack of all trades and master of none” means -
DPE-Main.option1: A person skilled in one thing but weak in others
DPE-Main.option2: A person interested in learning only practical skills
DPE-Main.option3: A person who avoids learning unfamiliar skills
DPE-Main.option4: A person skilled in many things but expert in none
DPE-Main.exp:
• The proverb “Jack of all trades and master of none” means - A person skilled in many things but expert in none.

• Jack of all trades and master of none:
- English Meaning: A person who can do many different types of work but is not an expert in any of them.
- Bangla Meaning: সবজান্তা শমশের/ নানা ধরনের কাজ কিছু কিছু জানে কিন্তু কোনটিতেই দক্ষ নয় এমন।

• Example Sentence: An artist with the right technology can become a jack-of-all-trades.
- Bangla Meaning: একজন শিল্পী/ কারিগর সঠিক প্রযুক্তির সহায়তা পেলে অনেক কিছুই করতে পারবে।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

DPE-Main.question: ৮) Who has prepared the report? (Make it passive)
DPE-Main.option1: By whom has the report been prepared?
DPE-Main.option2: By whom has the report prepared?
DPE-Main.option3: Whom has the report been prepared by?
DPE-Main.option4: By whom has been the report prepared?
DPE-Main.exp:
• Who যুক্ত Interrogative Sentence এর Active voice কে Passive voice এর রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Who এর পরিবর্তে By whom দিয়ে বাক্য শুরু হবে।
- tense ও person অনুযায়ী Auxiliary Verb বসে।
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এ subject হিসেবে বসে।
- অনেক সময় be/ being/ been বসাতে হয়।
- মূল verb এর past participle হয়।
- Question mark (?) হয়।

• Active voice: Who has prepared the report?
• Passive voice: By whom has the report been prepared?

Source:
1. English Wizard by Live Publications.
2. Advanced Learners Communicative English by Chowdhury and Hossain.

DPE-Main.question: ৯) Everyone respects a sincere leader. (make it Interrogative)
DPE-Main.option1: Who respects a sincere leader?
DPE-Main.option2: Who didn't respect a sincere leader?
DPE-Main.option3: Who don't respect a sincere leader?
DPE-Main.option4: Who doesn't respect a sincere leader?
DPE-Main.exp:
• Everybody/ Everyone/ All যুক্ত Assertive sentence কে Interrogative করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে এদের পরিবর্তে who বসে + don't/doesn't / didn't বসে+
- মূল Verb এর Present form বসে +
- মূল Verb এর পরের অংশ বসে প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন বসে।
 
• Assertive sentence: Everyone respects a sincere leader.
• Interrogative sentence: Who doesn't respect a sincere leader?
 
Source:
1. English Wizard by Live Publications.
2. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.

DPE-Main.question: ১০) Choose the correct spelling.
DPE-Main.option1: Jeopaedize
DPE-Main.option2: Jeopardize
DPE-Main.option3: Jeopaedise
DPE-Main.option4: Jaopardize
DPE-Main.exp:
• The correct spelling is "Jeopardize" (Verb).

• Jeopardize:
- English Meaning: To risk harming or destroying something/somebody
- Bangla Meaning: বিপদগ্রস্ত করা।

• Example sentence: His careless decision could jeopardize the company’s reputation.
- Bangla Meaning: তার অসতর্ক সিদ্ধান্ত কোম্পানির সুনামকে ঝুঁকির মধ্যে ফেলতে পারে।

Source: Merriam-Webster Dictionary, Oxford Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary.

DPE-Main.question: ১১) Pluck me some ripe fruits. (make it passive)
DPE-Main.option1: Let some ripe fruits be plucked by me.
DPE-Main.option2: Let some ripe fruits be plucked to me.
DPE-Main.option3: Let some ripe fruits be plucked at me.
DPE-Main.option4: Let some ripe fruits be plucked for me.
DPE-Main.exp:
• শুধুমাত্র মূল verb দিয়ে শুরু করা Imperative sentence এর Active voice কে Passive voice এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
 - Let দিয়ে Passive voice এর বাক্যটি শুরু হবে।
- Active voice এর object টি Passive voice এ subject হিসেবে বসে।
- be বসে।
- মূল verb এর past participle form বসে।
- অনেক ক্ষেত্রে Active voice এর Verb এরপর Passive voice এ by ছাড়া অন্য preparation বসে। যেমন: to, at, on, with, for ইত্যাদি।
- Pluck verb এর সাথে preposition হিসেবে for বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এ object হিসেবে বসে।

• Active voice: Pluck me some ripe fruits.
• Passive voice: Let some ripe fruits be plucked for me.

Source:
1. English Wizard by Live Publications.
2. Advanced Learners Communicative English by Chowdhury and Hossain.

DPE-Main.question: ১২)  The idiom "In vain" means -
DPE-Main.option1: With great effort
DPE-Main.option2: Without hesitation
DPE-Main.option3: Without success
DPE-Main.option4: With full confidence
DPE-Main.exp:
•  The idiom "In vain" means - Without success.

• In vain: 
- English Meaning: Without success or a result. 
- Bangla Meaning: নিষ্ফল, বৃথা।

• Example sentence: We walked on, looking in vain for a taxi.
- Bangla Meaning: আমরা ট্যাক্সির খোঁজ করতে করতে ব্যর্থভাবে হেঁটে চললাম।

Source: Live MCQ lecture.

DPE-Main.question: ১৩) When he was five, he left his house. (make it simple)
DPE-Main.option1: On five, he left his house.
DPE-Main.option2: At the age of five, he left his house.
DPE-Main.option3: In five, he left his house.
DPE-Main.option4: When he was age five, he left his house.
DPE-Main.exp:
• When যুক্ত Complex Sentence কে Simple Sentence করার নিয়ম:
- When উঠে যায় এবং when এরপরের অংশে যে Subject ও Verb থাকে টা উঠে যায়। 
- ছোট সময় বুঝালে at/ in বসে।
- ঋতু বুঝালে তার পূর্বে in বসে।
- বয়স বুঝালে at the age of বসে।
- Comma (,) এরপরের অংশ বসবে।

• Complex Sentence: When he was five, he left his house.
• Simple Sentence: At the age of five, he left his house.

Source:
1. English Wizard by Live Publications.
2. Advanced Learners Communicative English by Chowdhury and Hossain.

DPE-Main.question: ১৪) Choose the correct spelling.
DPE-Main.option1: Kindergarden
DPE-Main.option2: Kindergartan
DPE-Main.option3: Kindergerten
DPE-Main.option4: Kindergarten
DPE-Main.exp:
• The correct spelling is "Kindergarten" (Noun).

• Kindergarten:
- English meaning: A school or class to prepare children aged five for school.
- Bangla meaning: শিশু বিদ্যালয়; প্রাক-প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা প্রতিষ্ঠান।

• Example sentence: My daughter started kindergarten this year.
- Bangla meaning: আমার মেয়ে এ বছর কিন্ডারগার্টেনে ভর্তি হয়েছে।

Source: Accessible Dictionary, Oxford Dictionary, English-Bangla Dictionary.

DPE-Main.question: ১৫) The manager has approved the proposal. (Make it Passive)
DPE-Main.option1: The proposal has approved by the manager.
DPE-Main.option2: The proposal is approved by the manager.
DPE-Main.option3: The proposal has being approved by the manager.
DPE-Main.option4: The proposal has been approved by the manager.
DPE-Main.exp:
• Present Perfect Tense এর Active voice থেকে Passive voice এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Active voice এর object টি Passive voice এ subject হিসেবে বসে।
- Subject অনুযায়ী has been/ have been বসে।
- মূল verb এর past participle form বসে।
- by বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এ object হিসেবে বসে।

• Active voice: The manager has approved the proposal.
• Passive voice: The proposal has been approved by the manager.

Source:
1. English Wizard by Live Publications.
2. Advanced Learners Communicative English by Chowdhury and Hossain.

DPE-Main.question: ১৬) He went to the market so that he could buy some groceries. (Make it simple)
DPE-Main.option1: He went to the market buying some groceries.
DPE-Main.option2: He went to the market to buy some groceries.
DPE-Main.option3: He went to the market for buy some groceries.
DPE-Main.option4: He went to the market bought some groceries.
DPE-Main.exp:
• So that যুক্ত complex sentence কে simple sentence এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- প্রদত্ত sentence এর প্রথম থেকে so এর পূর্ব পর্যন্ত বসে,
- so that থেকে may/ might/ can/ could পর্যন্ত উঠে যায়,
- to বসে,
- প্রদত্ত sentence এর বাকি অংশ বসে।

• Complex sentence: He went to the market so that he could buy some groceries.
• Simple sentence: He went to the market to buy some groceries.

Source:
1. English Wizard by Live Publications.
2. Advanced Learners Communicative English by Chowdhury and Hossain.

DPE-Main.question: ১৭) The word "Luminary" means -
DPE-Main.option1: A person of great importance or distinction
DPE-Main.option2: A person of limited knowledge or ability
DPE-Main.option3: A person who avoids public attention
DPE-Main.option4: A person who works in an ordinary position
DPE-Main.exp:
• The word "Luminary" means - A person of great importance or distinction.

• Luminary (Noun):
- English meaning: A person of prominence or brilliant achievement.
- Bangla meaning: উজ্জ্বল জ্যোতিষ্ক; মহান নেতা; প্রতিভাবান ব্যক্তিত্ব।

• Example sentence: He is a luminary in the field of literature.
- Bangla meaning: তিনি সাহিত্যের ক্ষেত্রে একজন বিশিষ্ট ব্যক্তি।

Source: Merriam-Webster Dictionary, Oxford Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary.

DPE-Main.question: ১৮) The idiom "Keep the wolf from the door" means -
DPE-Main.option1: To protect oneself from physical danger
DPE-Main.option2: To avoid poverty or financial hardship
DPE-Main.option3: To prevent an enemy from entering
DPE-Main.option4: To escape from an unpleasant situation
DPE-Main.exp:
• The idiom "Keep the wolf from the door" means - To avoid poverty or financial hardship.

• Keep the wolf from the door:
- English Meaning: To have just enough money to be able to eat and live.
- Bangla Meaning: খেয়ে পড়ে বাঁচার জন্য পর্যাপ্ত অর্থ থাকা।

• Example Sentence: I work part-time to pay the mortgage and keep the wolf from the door.
- Bangla Meaning: বন্ধকগুলো পরিশোধ ও খেয়ে পড়ে বাঁচার জন্য আমাকে একটা খন্ডকালীন চাকুরীও করতে হয়।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

DPE-Main.question: ১৯) What a wonderful performance it was! (Make it assertive)
DPE-Main.option1: It was not a wonderful performance.
DPE-Main.option2: It was a very wonderful performance.
DPE-Main.option3: It is a very wonderful performance.
DPE-Main.option4: It had been a wonderful performance.
DPE-Main.exp:
• Exclamatory Sentence কে Assertive Sentence-এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম:
- Sub + verb + (a/ an প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী) + very (adjective এর পূর্বে)/ great (noun এর পূর্বে) + বাকী অংশ।
- Exclamatory word (যেমন: What, How) সরিয়ে Assertive Sentence গঠন করা হয়।
- "What" বা "How" -এর পরিবর্তে adjective-এর পূর্বে very/most এবং noun-এর পূর্বে great বসে।

• Structure: Subject + verb + a/ an + very/ great + adjective + বাকী অংশ।

• Exclamatory sentence: What a wonderful performance it was!
• Assertive sentence: It was a very wonderful performance.

Source:
1. English Wizard by Live Publications.
2. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.

DPE-Main.question: ২০) The cheetah is the fastest land animal. (Make it comparative)
DPE-Main.option1: The cheetah is faster than many land animals.
DPE-Main.option2: The cheetah is faster than other land animals.
DPE-Main.option3: The cheetah is faster than any other land animal.
DPE-Main.option4: The cheetah is faster than many other land animal.
DPE-Main.exp:
• The + superlative degree থেকে comparative degree তে রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম:
- Superlative degree এর Subject টি প্রথমে বসে,
- subject অনুসারে Verb বসে,
- The উঠে যাবে,
- Superlative এর Comparative form + than any other (singular noun)/ than all other (plural noun) হবে,
- বাকি অংশ।

• Superlative degree: The cheetah is the fastest land animal. 
• Comparative degree: The cheetah is faster than any other land animal.

DPE-Main.question: ২১) Gold is one of the most valuable metals in the world. (Make it positive)
DPE-Main.option1: Very few metals in the world are as valuable as gold.
DPE-Main.option2: Very few metal in the world are as valuable as gold.
DPE-Main.option3: Very few metals in the world is as valuable as gold.
DPE-Main.option4: No other metal in the world is as valuable as gold.
DPE-Main.exp:
• One of the থাকলে যুক্ত superlative sentence কে Positive sentence এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে very few বসে,
- Superlative degree এর পরের অংশ,
- verb এর plural form,
- as + superlative degree এর positive form + as,
- প্রদত্ত sentence এর Subject.

• Superlative sentence: Gold is one of the most valuable metals in the world. 
• Positive sentence: Very few metals in the world are as valuable as gold.

Source:
1. English Wizard by Live Publications.
2. Advanced Learners Communicative English by Chowdhury and Hossain.

DPE-Main.question: ২৪) It is a very peaceful village. (Transform into an exclamatory sentence)
DPE-Main.option1: How a peaceful village it is!
DPE-Main.option2: What a peaceful village it is!
DPE-Main.option3: Wow peaceful the village is!
DPE-Main.option4: What peaceful the village is!
DPE-Main.exp:
• Assertive sentence থেকে Exclamatory sentence করার নিয়ম:
- সাধারণত Assertive sentence কে নিচের নিয়ম অনুযায়ী Exclamatory sentence এ রূপান্তর হয়
- শুরুতে what (a/ an)/ how + adjective + subject + verb বাকী অংশ (যদি থাকে) + (!) বিস্ময়সূচক চিহ্ন বসে।
- যদি Adjective-এর আগে a/ an থাকে What a/ an ব্যবহার করা হয়।
- যদি Adjective-এর আগে a/ an না থাকে How ব্যবহার।
- এরপর আসে Adjective + Subject + Verb.
- শেষে exclamation mark (!) ব্যবহার করা হয়।

• Assertive sentence: It is a very peaceful village. 
• Exclamatory sentence: What a peaceful village it is!

Source:
1. English Wizard by Live Publications.
2. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.

DPE-Main.question: ২৫) The committee agreed to postpone the meeting. (Make it passive)
DPE-Main.option1: The committee agreed that the meeting should postponed.
DPE-Main.option2: The committee agreed that the meeting should be postponed.
DPE-Main.option3: The committee agreed that the meeting should been postponed.
DPE-Main.option4: The committee agreed that the meeting should being postponed.
DPE-Main.exp:
• Agree/ be anxious/ arrange/ determine/ be determined/ decide/ demand + infinitive object যুক্ত sentence কে active voice কে passive voice করার নিয়ম:
- প্রদত্ত active voice এর subject ও verb বসবে।
- that বসে।
- Infinitive এর পরের object বসবে।
- should be বসে।
- Infinitive এর পরের verb এর past participle বসে।

• Active voice: The committee agreed to postpone the meeting.
• Passive voice: The committee agreed that the meeting should be postponed.

Source:
1. English Wizard by Live Publications.
2. Advanced Learners Communicative English by Chowdhury and Hossain.

DPE-Main.question: ২৬) Hurrah! Our school has won the championship. (Transform it into an assertive sentence)
DPE-Main.option1: Our school has win the championship.
DPE-Main.option2: It is a matter of sorrow that our school has won the championship.
DPE-Main.option3: It is a matter of joy that our school has won the championship.
DPE-Main.option4: It is a matter of wonder that our school has won the championship.
DPE-Main.exp:
• Hurrah যুক্ত Exclamatory Sentence-কে assertive করতে হলে:
- Assertive Sentence এ Hurrah এর পরিবর্তে It is a matter of joy বসবে।
- that যোগ হবে।
- বাকী অংশ যেভাবে ছিল সেভাবে বসবে।

• Exclamatory sentence: Hurrah! Our school has won the championship.
• Assertive sentence: It is a matter of joy that our school has won the championship.

Source:
1. English Wizard by Live Publications.
2. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.

DPE-Main.question: ২৭) Had I the opportunity to meet him! (Make it assertive)
DPE-Main.option1: I wish I have the opportunity to meet him.
DPE-Main.option2: I wish had I the opportunity to meet him.
DPE-Main.option3: I wish had the opportunity to meet him.
DPE-Main.option4: I wish I had the opportunity to meet him.
DPE-Main.exp:
• Exclamatory sentence যদি If, were, would, could, that, had ইত্যাদি দ্বারা শুরু হয়, তাহলে Assertive Sentence এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে ঐ Word গুলাের পরিবর্তে 'I wish' ব্যবহৃত হয়।
- তারপর subject + verb + বাকি অংশ বসে।
-  সব শেষে Note of exclamation mark এর বদলে Full stop ব্যবহৃত হয়।

• Exclamatory sentence: Had I the opportunity to meet him!
• Assertive sentence: I wish I had the opportunity to meet him.

DPE-Main.question: ২৮) The phrase "Loaves and fishes" means -

DPE-Main.option2: Religious beliefs or spiritual values

DPE-Main.question: ২৯) Rafiq has finished the assignment. (Transform into an interrogative sentence)
DPE-Main.option1: Hasn't Rafiq finished the assignment?
DPE-Main.option2: Has Rafiq finish the assignment?
DPE-Main.option3: Does Rafiq has finished the assignment?
DPE-Main.option4: Don't Rafiq has finished the assignment?
DPE-Main.exp:
• সাহায্যকারী verb/ be verb (am/ is/ are/ was/ were/ have/ has/ had/ shall/ will/ should/ would ইত্যাদি) যুক্ত assertive sentence কে Interrogative sentence - এ রূপান্তর করতে হলে assertive sentence টিকে Negative Interrogative Sentence এ রূপান্তর করতে হয়।

- প্রথমে Auxiliary verb-টিকে বাক্যের শুরুতে বসে,
- তারপর subject বসাতে হয়,
- বাক্যের অর্থ অপরিবর্তিত রাখার জন্য,
- বাক্যটি affirmative হলে Negative প্রশ্ন,
- আর Negative হলে positive প্রশ্ন করতে হয়, 
- শেষে প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন (?) বসে।

• Assertive sentence: Rafiq has finished the assignment. 
• Interrogative sentence: Hasn't Rafiq finished the assignment?

Source:
1. English Wizard by Live Publications.
2. A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.
